name: io.github.tonyyang0504/douyin_ecommerce-mcp
description: Douyin E-commerce — 抖店 (Doudian) seller + 精选联盟 / 巨量百应 + Doudian Open Platform (ecommerce suppliers):

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DOUYIN_ECOMMERCE_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Doudian app's app_key (抖店开放平台 → 应用管理).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DOUYIN_ECOMMERCE_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The app's app_secret; it signs every call (hmac-sha256).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DOUYIN_ECOMMERCE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shop access_token from /token/create (self-built apps: grant_type authorization_self with your shop_id). It lasts about 7 days; renew it with /token/refresh and update this value — the server does not renew it.
